title: Choose the companion composition
question: Glance-then-expand stays. Which composition should Orch use?

options.label: Side hinge
options.lineage: Eclipse as a hinge on the top-bar, not a second app
options.thesis: The glance hangs from Eclipse; Open Orch slides a workbench from that same hinge.
options.viewport: Agency Tracker with Eclipse needs-you. Glance card docks under the disc: status, composer with / and @, two live threads, Open Orch. Expand is a right-hinged panel: Search + Settle, thread with CoT, activity Inspect, todos, citations, collapse.
options.risk: Reads as a generic right chat drawer if the hinge from Eclipse is weak.

raised.raise: Glance and expand are two named instances of one panel, not two layouts.
Eclipse moods stay slack, balanced, stressed, and failed as distinct states.
Operator Violet stays on the bite-dot and live status only.

options.label: Two-lane glance
options.lineage: Needs-you and running as separate lanes
options.thesis: The glance splits live work into Needs you and Running, then Open Orch keeps those lanes.
options.viewport: Glance composer on top, two columns of threads, Open Orch. Expand keeps Needs you / Running / Settled as stacked lanes beside the thread interiors.
options.risk: Empty lanes look unfinished when nothing is running.

options.label: Composer spotlight
options.lineage: Linear Ask / command field that grows into a thread
options.thesis: The glance is a command field; live threads are results under the query.
options.viewport: Large composer first, mono hint for / and @, thread results, Open Orch. Expand docks that same composer under a full thread with Settle in a slim rail.
options.risk: Inbox status is easy to miss if the field eats the glance.

options.label: Named instances
options.lineage: variable-font specimen: one face, two named weights
options.thesis: Glance and expand are the same card at two named sizes, interpolating in place.
options.viewport: Compact instance hangs from Eclipse. Open Orch grows that exact card over the page; Settle, thread, CoT, activity, todos, citations stay in the same object.
options.case: Beats a two-chrome model on clarity: one object, two instances. Narrower on glance scan if the compact instance is still a mini-chat.
options.risk: The morph can feel like a window resize instead of a companion.

options.label: Swelling lobe
options.lineage: zoo guide map: one lobe swells until its coast leaves the frame
options.thesis: Orch is one lobe hanging from Eclipse that swells to own the page; Settled is a hole the Agency page shows through.
options.viewport: Rounded glance lobe under Eclipse with status, composer, threads, Open Orch. Expand swells that lobe across the Tracker; a window of the page remains as Settled.
options.case: Strong on the grow ritual. Risks novelty against Agency’s rectangular chrome.
options.risk: Organic corners can fight the shell if they become decoration.

options.label: Keyed pages
options.thesis: Threads as numbered pages with a HOLD flag.
options.viewport: Not shown. Teletext paging fights a quiet instrument.
options.case: Loses identification and clarity. Kept: running as a designed HOLD flag, not a missing row.
options.kept: Running is a designed HOLD flag, not a missing row.

options.label: Tension states
options.thesis: Settle as releasing tension in a sculpture.
options.case: Operators do not identify with sculpture. Kept mood states raised onto Side hinge.
options.kept: Slack, balanced, stressed, failed Eclipse moods.

options.label: Edge color
options.case: Already DESIGN.md. Kept as a raise, not a layout.
options.kept: Violet only on the Eclipse bite-dot and live status.

options.label: Crisis wall
options.viewport: Rejected by brand: no neon, no hazard bands.
options.case: Loses both axes against a quiet instrument.
options.kept: Status must be readable at a glance without a second app.
